'''Jason Drake''' is a Star Wars CCG player who appears in the center of a photo of [[Winfried Sommerfeld]]'s visit to Turlock, California, where Sommerfeld played [[Paul Todd Feldman]].<ref name="torch-turlock">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/turlock.html Winfred Sommerfeld and Paul Todd Feldman], Torch Industries (members.aol.com/drtorch). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030715063940/http://members.aol.com/drtorch/turlock.html Internet Archive]</ref>
